# Film Archive courtyard still source

The original Hong Kong Film Archive e-book and full-page renders retain the figure context, film title and copyright credit. [Primary PDF](https://www.filmarchive.gov.hk/documents/18995340/19057029/Oral%2BHistory%2BSeries_eng07_ebook.pdf). The colophon (PDF page 289) credits the Archive and copyright 2018.

PDF page 136 / printed page 134 identifies the selected still as *The Magic Blade* (1976), © Celestial Pictures Ltd., all rights reserved. It is reviewed as a courtyard night-lighting reference for Yihong. The inferred night appearance and missing warm practical are recorded in that site's metadata. The raw original JPX stream is retained under `../../yihong-yuan/`; the full-page render preserves the overlaid credit. This is copyrighted reference material, not a shipped texture or an open-licensed asset.

PDF page 125 / printed page 123 shows *The 36th Chamber of Shaolin* training bags. It does not fill the required terminal-cell reference. The Magic Blade courtyard does not fill the required cave-corridor slot.
